items.title: Nikkei discloses third data breach in a month, 1.8M records exposed
items.summary:
Nikkei Inc. disclosed a third data breach in about a month, exposing 1.83 million personal records.
The breach involved personal information but no further details were released.

items.title: WordPress SEO plugin Rank Math compromised to backdoor websites
items.summary:
Downloads of the Rank Math PRO WordPress plugin from the vendor’s official site carried malware.
The malware planted hidden backdoors in a supply‑chain attack.

items.title: Researchers Infiltrate Microsoft Tech Support Scam Operation
items.summary:
Researchers infiltrated a large‑scale Microsoft impersonation scam.
The operation used a malicious traffic distribution system run by a Russian organization and abused thousands of Cloudflare links.

items.title: Grocery giant Ahold Delhaize confirms cyberattack forced US and European systems offline
items.summary:
Ahold Delhaize confirmed a cyberattack that forced its US and European systems offline.
This marks a second security incident in two years.

items.title: 'AdFection' Turns Ad Impressions Into Zero-Click Spyware Delivery
items.summary:
AdFection exploits targeted ad bidding to deliver zero‑click spyware.
The technique allows vendors to identify and track individuals and organizations.

items.title: Judge denies WhatsApp’s bid to hold spyware maker in contempt for allegedly targeting users
items.summary:
A federal judge denied WhatsApp’s request to hold NSO Group in contempt.
The judge cited insufficient disclosure by WhatsApp regarding the alleged spyware use.
items.source: The Record from Recorded Future News

items.title: ConnectWise suspends Cloud Backup service after supply chain attack
items.summary:
ConnectWise suspended its Cloud Backup service after confirming unauthorized access to the environment.
The action followed a supply‑chain attack.
items.source: The Record from Recorded Future News

items.title: Hackers hijack AOMEI update servers to secretly spread malware
items.summary:
Hackers compromised AOMEI’s update servers to distribute malware via a promotional feature in its backup software.
They briefly tampered with configuration files before restoring them to hide the attack.

items.title: ConnectWise Disables Cloud Backups Amid Concerns for Downstream MSPs
items.summary:
Researchers found attackers authenticated into Microsoft 365 tenants using ConnectWise credentials.
ConnectWise said customer impact remains unconfirmed.

items.title: Bullhorn takes staffing platform offline to contain cyberattack
items.summary:
Bullhorn disabled access to its staffing platform to contain a cyberattack that caused a system‑wide outage.
The move was taken to prevent further spread of the attack.

items.title: Two more Serbian opposition figures targeted with spyware, researchers say
items.summary: Pegasus spyware infected the phone of the University of Belgrade rector, marking a third discovery in a series of attacks on Serbian opposition figures ahead of national elections.
items.source: The Record from Recorded Future News

items.title: Wyden seeks adoption of encryption tech at hundreds of federal agencies to protect visitors’ sensitive traffic
items.summary: Senator Wyden calls for encryption technology adoption across federal agencies to safeguard sensitive visitor traffic, citing risks to whistleblowers and other vulnerable groups.

items.title: Security patches need patches now that attackers have AI
items.summary: Terra reports a sharp increase in GitHub security fixes that become broken within 90 days, highlighting the need for timely patching amid AI‑driven attacks.

items.title: Siemens Software Center Vulnerability Exploited in ClickFix Malware Attacks
items.summary: Attackers exploited a Siemens Software Center vulnerability by pairing a signed copy with malicious DLLs, delivering malware through ClickFix lures to Windows PCs.

items.title: Hackers Exploit Plex2Shell Flaws to Install Crypto Miners and Linux Proxy Backdoor
items.summary: Threat actors chain four Plex Media Server vulnerabilities—Plex2Shell—to install cryptocurrency miners and a reverse‑proxy backdoor on Linux systems.

items.title: OpenCode hack exposes API keys amid AI distillation attacks
items.summary: OpenCode informs users that API keys for external providers were exposed in a breach, potentially enabling AI distillation attacks.

items.title: Ahold Delhaize confirms 'malicious actions' behind cyber outages affecting grocery brands
items.summary: Ahold Delhaize attributes recent system outages across its U.S. and European brands to a cyberattack that disrupted operations and affected shoppers.
items.source: The Record from Recorded Future News

items.title: Your Next Insider Threat Won’t be Human: Securing AI Agents From the Outside in
items.summary: The article argues that AI agents must be governed by external controls to mitigate insider threats, proposing security operations teams implement such measures.

items.title: Popular WordPress SEO Plugin Rank Math PRO Hijacked to Deliver Self-Restoring Backdoor
items.summary: Rank Math PRO plugin copies released between Oct 15–16 were compromised with a self‑restoring backdoor; sites that installed them should consider themselves compromised.

items.title: Authentication Bypass, Remote Code Execution, and Database Read in Eptura Archibus (FIXED)
items.summary: Rapid7 identified three vulnerabilities in Eptura Archibus—a legacy API endpoint allowing authentication bypass, remote code execution, and full database read—now fixed.

items.title: Russian social media giant VK faces disruptions after data center drone strike
items.summary: VK users report difficulties loading news feeds, music, and other features following a data center drone strike that began Sunday.
items.source: The Record from Recorded Future News

items.title: Drupal Warns of Fast Exploitation Risk for Critical Core RCE Flaw
items.summary: Drupal warns of a critical remote code execution flaw affecting Entity List and Field UI modules, with exploit paths via contributed modules.

items.title: DHS to ban DeepSeek from federal civilian agencies
items.summary: The Department of Homeland Security has prohibited the use of DeepSeek in federal civilian agencies due to national security concerns, including data transmission to China and malware risk.

items.title: Exploited Vulnerabilities Typically Take Three Months to Patch, Moody’s Finds
items.summary: A Moody’s report finds that known exploited vulnerabilities take a median of 87 days to patch, indicating a typical three-month window.

items.title: Rank Math PRO WordPress Plugin Compromised in Supply Chain Attack
items.summary: Rank Math PRO version 3.0.123 was compromised by malware injection in October 2026, affecting packages distributed between Oct 15‑16.

items.title: Rapid7 Analysis: NetScaler intrusions chaining CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88779
items.summary: Rapid7 analysis reveals Citrix NetScaler ADC appliances on build 14.1 were compromised via CVE‑2026‑88771 and CVE‑2026‑88779, enabling root code execution and persistence.

items.title: Microsoft fixes game, app crashes caused by recent Windows update
items.summary: Microsoft addressed a bug in the September 2026 Windows 11 preview update that caused games and apps using AC‑3 audio decoding to crash.

items.title: CVE-2026-102764: Critical BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass Exploited in the Wild
items.summary: BeyondTrust disclosed CVE‑2026‑102764, a critical authentication bypass in Remote Support that allows unauthenticated attackers to perform file operations on affected appliances.

items.title: OnlyFans Copyright Takedowns Expose Compromised Websites
items.summary: OnlyFans copyright takedown requests are exposing compromised university and government websites, revealing attackers manipulating search results.

items.title: Conduent Agrees to Pay $80m to Settle Data Breach Class Action
items.summary: Conduent agreed to pay $80 million to settle a class action lawsuit over a 2024 data breach that exposed healthcare data of 62 million people.

items.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: 98 Zero-Days, Rogue AI Agents, $100M Crypto Theft, 700 Supermarkets Hit and More
items.summary: The weekly recap highlights 98 zero-day vulnerabilities, rogue AI agents, a $100M crypto theft, and attacks on 700 supermarkets, among other incidents.

items.title: Inside the Underground Market for Know Your Client Services
items.summary: The article examines how cybercriminals sell forged IDs, deepfake videos, and live verification services to bypass KYC checks, detailing underground operations and techniques.

items.title: The Evolving Cybersecurity Lexicon: Vulnerability Discovery to Resilience
items.summary: The piece discusses how an industry focus on vulnerability discovery has limited teams' ability to plan for resilience, outlining the evolving cybersecurity lexicon.

items.title: F5 releases out-of-band patches for critical NGINX vulnerabilities
items.summary: F5 released out-of-band patches for multiple NGINX web server flaws, including three critical vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to execute code.

items.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
items.summary: Federal investigators link executives of two ransomware negotiation firms to the ShinyHunters group that stole FBI data, with one executive allegedly assisting the attackers.

items.title: Axonius AI Workforce pairs asset intelligence with automated action
items.summary: Axonius introduced AI Workforce, a virtual worker platform that monitors environments, identifies high-risk exposures, remediates issues, and reports progress with human‑in‑the‑loop approvals.

items.title: ConnectWise suspends Cloud Backup service after attackers abuse its Microsoft 365 access
items.summary: ConnectWise suspended its Cloud Backup service after attackers used compromised credentials from the application to access customers' Microsoft 365 accounts.

items.title: OpenCode Breach Could Affect OpenAI, Anthropic and Google
items.summary: A breach of the OpenCode Console may expose API keys for Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google Gemini users, potentially compromising their services.

items.title: Sweet Security adds one-click protection for vulnerable cloud workloads
items.summary: Sweet Security launched Virtual Patching, a one‑click solution that protects cloud and AI workloads from identified vulnerabilities until permanent fixes are deployed.

items.title: ConnectWise Suspends Cloud Services in Response to Cyberattack
items.summary: ConnectWise has suspended its cloud services following a cyberattack and is conducting remediation and security validation; services remain unavailable.

items.title: One Compromised Login Exposed Millions of California Students’ Records
items.summary:
Intruders exploited a compromised login to access an ETS SFTP server.
They extracted California student records dating back to 2006.

items.title: Hackers steal customer data from major Russian hosting provider FirstVDS
items.summary:
Hackers stole passwords, access credentials, and other sensitive data from FirstVDS customers.
The breach was enabled by a vulnerability in the provider’s server‑management software.
items.source: The Record from Recorded Future News

items.title: Exploited Fortinet Bug Linked to Stealthy FortiGate Implant in Telecom Hack
items.summary:
A stealthy FortiGate implant was deployed against a telecommunications organization.
The attack leveraged a known Fortinet bug to gain persistence.

items.title: Training AIs to Solve CAPTCHAs
items.summary:
Vision‑language models can solve visual CAPTCHAs without task‑specific training.
Each new instance requires the same compute, while specialized detectors answer quickly for known categories.

items.title: With open-weight AI, more of the security burden falls on enterprises
items.summary:
Running open‑weight AI models on enterprise infrastructure shifts safety and security responsibilities to the organization.
Providers would normally handle these controls.

items.title: ConnectWise Shuts Off Cloud Services After ‘Unauthorized Access’ to Microsoft 365 Tenants
items.summary:
ConnectWise took its Cloud Backup, SaaS Security, and Cloud Management services offline.
The move followed discovery of potential unauthorized access to client Microsoft 365 tenants via stolen tokens.

items.title: Fake Web3 Accelerator Uses npm Packages to Spread Malware and Hijack AI Agent Traffic
items.summary:
A fake Web3 accelerator distributed information‑stealing malware and backdoors through malicious npm packages.
It falsely advertised free AI credits for Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini.

items.title: US Cybersecurity Job Postings Fall 26%, Hitting Four Year Low
items.summary:
CyberSN reports a 26% decline in cybersecurity leadership job postings in 2026.
This marks the lowest level in four years.

items.title: Spyware found on devices belonging to prominent Serbian critics as elections loom
items.summary:
Spyware was detected on devices of prominent Serbian critics, including a university rector and a prosecutor.
The incidents occurred weeks before parliamentary elections.

items.title: Cybercriminals favor Microsoft over Apple and Google in brand phishing attacks
items.summary:
Check Point Research found Microsoft was impersonated in 33% of brand phishing attacks in Q3 2026.
Apple and Google each accounted for 8%, while other brands had much lower shares.

items.title: MITRE ATT&CK v20 Catalogs AI Abuse, MFA Bypass, Water Utility Attacks
items.summary: MITRE ATT&CK v20 adds 15 new detection strategies—six for Enterprise and nine for Industrial Control Systems—supported by 38 analytics, and catalogs AI abuse, MFA bypass, and water utility attacks.

items.title: Microsoft: October Windows Server updates break Exchange sign-in, mail flow
items.summary: Microsoft confirmed that Windows Server updates released in October are causing OWA sign‑in failures and mail delivery issues on some Exchange Server systems.

items.title: Anthropic Acquires Confidential AI Startup Opaque Systems
items.summary: Anthropic has acquired Opaque Systems, a startup that developed hardware‑based technology enabling AI to use sensitive data while keeping it protected.

items.title: Unpatched Broadcom Wi-Fi Flaw Lets Attackers in Range Run Code as Root on Routers
items.summary: A flaw in Broadcom’s Wi‑Fi setup software allows attackers within radio range to execute code as root on Broadcom‑based routers without a network password or pairing step.

items.title: OpenCode Console Breach May Have Exposed OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API Keys
items.summary: An intruder accessed a legacy OpenCode system on October 16 and may have exposed third‑party AI provider keys stored in OpenCode Console, potentially compromising OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API credentials.

items.title: Bearer CLI: Free, source-available code security scanning tool (SAST)
items.summary: Bearer CLI is a free, source‑available static application security testing tool that scans source code for vulnerabilities and prioritizes findings by the sensitive data they touch.

items.title: RPO and RTO explained with a real disaster recovery example
items.summary: A video by BlackBox Hosting CEO Matthew Burden explains the difference between recovery point objective (RPO) and recovery time objective (RTO) using a practical disaster recovery scenario.

items.title: ConnectWise turns off its SaaS-y backup, security, and management services to probe security SNAFU
items.summary: ConnectWise reportedly shut down its SaaS backup, security, and management services to investigate a security incident involving a potential takeover of Microsoft 365 accounts.

items.title: Half the AI bot traffic hammering your website comes from Meta
items.summary: DataDome’s AI Traffic Report Q3 2026 shows that 41.5% of AI bot traffic to websites comes from Meta, with Muse generating 29.1 million requests in its first 12 days of full availability.

items.title: Ransomware pressure now reaches employees’ homes and families
items.summary: Semperis’ 2026 Ransomware Risk Report found that 37% of surveyed organizations reported attackers threatening employees’ family members or friends, indicating ransomware pressure extending beyond the workplace.

items.title: Linux KVM guest-host escape rated critical, may represent a new way to attack penguin-powered networking
items.summary: Critical KVM guest-host escape (CVE-2026-99999) rated 9.3 allows Linux guests to escape to the host, potentially enabling attacks on penguin‑powered networking.

items.title: Hackers exploit SiteGuard WAF flaw to run commands as admins
items.summary: Attackers exploit OS command injection in SiteGuard Server Edition, enabling execution as root or SYSTEM on affected servers.

items.title: US Cybersecurity Job Postings Fall 26% as AI Security Engineer Demand Soars
items.summary: CyberSN report shows a 26% decline in US cybersecurity job postings, while demand for AI security engineers rises.

items.title: ConnectWise Suspends Cloud Backup After Attackers Compromise Microsoft 365 Tenants
items.summary: ConnectWise disabled seven application identities after attackers accessed them and compromised Microsoft 365 tenants. Investigation is ongoing. The disabled identity includes ConnectWise Cloud Backup.

items.title: Week in review: Hidden implant in Ledger wallets linked to $93M theft, 1,500+ npm packages exposed
items.summary: Review highlights a hidden implant in Ledger wallets linked to a $93 million theft and the exposure of over 1,500 npm packages. It also mentions Strands Box, an open‑source sandbox for AI agents.
